SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.name FROM kb_category c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) AS postCount FROM kb_entry e JOIN kb_category kc ON kc.id = e.category_id WHERE e.status = 1 AND kc.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id) ) stat ON stat.rootId = c.id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(stat.postCount, 0) DESC, c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.name FROM kb_category c JOIN ( SELECT pref.rootId, SUM(pref.score) AS score, MAX(pref.lastTime) AS lastTime FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) * 1.0 AS score, MAX(h.created_at) AS lastTime FROM user_browse_history h JOIN kb_entry e ON e.id = h.biz_id JOIN kb_category kc ON kc.id = e.category_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.biz_type = 2 AND e.status = 1 AND kc.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id)
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) * 3.0 AS score, MAX(v.created_at) AS lastTime FROM qa_vote v JOIN kb_entry e ON e.id = v.biz_id JOIN kb_category kc ON kc.id = e.category_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.biz_type = 4 AND v.vote_type = 1 AND e.status = 1 AND kc.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id)
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id) AS rootId, COUNT(1) * 4.0 AS score, MAX(v.created_at) AS lastTime FROM qa_vote v JOIN kb_entry e ON e.id = v.biz_id JOIN kb_category kc ON kc.id = e.category_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.biz_type = 6 AND v.vote_type = 1 AND e.status = 1 AND kc.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(kc.parent_id, kc.id) ) pref GROUP BY pref.rootId ) score ON score.rootId = c.id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY score.score DESC, score.lastTime DESC, c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
